data_objects.name: debate_team_standings
data_objects.meaning: Standings-style records for two-person school debate teams, including wins, original and standardized team labels, and sheet-level round and weighting metadata.
data_objects.notes: The physical CSV header is not the semantic field-name row: the first data row supplies in-band labels. Two source columns are empty spacers.

variables.name: JAMES LOGAN
variables.meaning: Team win count after an initial in-band cell labeled Wins.

variables.name: Unnamed: 1
variables.meaning: Names of the two team members after an initial in-band cell labeled Name.

variables.name: Unnamed: 2
variables.meaning: Original team code combining a school label with member initials, after an initial in-band cell labeled Code.

variables.name: Unnamed: 3
variables.meaning: School represented by the team, after an initial in-band cell labeled School.

variables.name: Unnamed: 4
variables.meaning: Empty spacer field with no supplied semantic label or values.

variables.name: Unnamed: 5
variables.meaning: Empty spacer field with no supplied semantic label or values.

variables.name: Unnamed: 6
variables.meaning: Standardized team-name variant, identified by the in-band label STANDARD TEAM NAME.

variables.name: Unnamed: 7
variables.meaning: Number-of-rounds metadata stored once beneath the in-band label NUM ROUNDS rather than repeated for each team.

variables.name: Unnamed: 8
variables.meaning: Dimensionless weighting metadata stored once beneath the in-band label WEIGHTING rather than repeated for each team.

structure.description: The first data row is an embedded semantic header and is not a team observation; subsequent rows each describe one two-person team.
Team records are ordered by non-increasing win count. The original code and standardized name are alternative labels rather than documented stable identifiers.

uncertainties: The role of the physical header text JAMES LOGAN is not documented by the table.
The intended scope of NUM ROUNDS and WEIGHTING is inferred to be table-level from their single placement; no accompanying metadata confirms it.
No semantics are supplied for the two empty spacer columns.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv and its neutral packet were used as evidence.
